title: Relation Pass Output
description: Stage B of section-ir-0.9: structural edges over the full node set. Sees every node, so cross-section composition and measure-subject binding are captured here with no forward references.

relations.description: Structural node<->node edges between census nodes.

relation.description: part_of = internal composition between Methods/ExperimentSetups; builds_on = the contribution extends external prior work it derives from; uses = the contribution depends on an external method/dataset as a tool; assumes = a theorem/result Method holds under a theoretical_setting/structural_class ExperimentSetup; co_contribution = two co-equal contributions of one paper (emit once, not fake part_of); compares_to = contrasted peers; evaluates = a Measure measures a Method.

provenance.description: Location markers for this unit: top-level section anchors such as ['\u00a71', '\u00a72']
